processNotes.theRecurringDEFECTCLASS: C-044, C-045, C-046 and C-047 were ALL the same shape: a check that PASSED while inspecting less than it appeared to. A name-level equation blind to types; a grep blind to a binary file; an assertion satisfiable by two independent mechanisms so it pinned neither; a green suite over a product whose tools all throw. LESSON, now standing: a construction that enforces an invariant must ALSO assert that it actually ran — a floor on how much it inspected, an explicit allowlist instead of a silent skip, a premise that fails when the fixture becomes unverifiable.
processNotes.mutationRevertTrap: A mutation harness that reverts with `git checkout <file>` DISCARDS UNCOMMITTED WORK. It threw away half of C-035 mid-round. Snapshot with `cp` before the first mutation; restore from the snapshot; verify with `cmp`.
processNotes.agentStrayFileTrap: Test-writers told to typecheck by copying into conductor/tests/ and deleting have twice left or removed files at a path the orchestrator was also using. A CHANGED TEST COUNT (994 -> 995) is the tell that something arrived or vanished. After ANY agent returns, run git status before trusting a gate result.
processNotes.autoformatIsNotAnAgentEdit: AUTOFORMAT_SRC_ON_CONFIGURE runs clang-format at cmake CONFIGURE time over router/ and tools/. A delivered C++ file will DIFFER from its parked copy on formatting alone - compare whitespace-normalized before suspecting an agent edited a test. Also: an incremental ninja build does NOT reconfigure, so a file can be committed format-dirty and only get rewritten later (metrics.hpp did). Run clang-format --dry-run --Werror on anything new under router/ or tools/.
processNotes.disclosedSurvivorsArePayingOff: Three consecutive implementers disclosed a surviving mutation rather than hiding it, and every disclosure became a real fix (C-042, C-046, C-047). Keep asking for the mutation table and keep treating a survivor as information rather than a failure.
processNotes.readTheInterface: Read the exported SIGNATURE, never infer it from one call site. That mistake cost one correction round already.
processNotes.reviewResultTrap: A review workflow returning an EMPTY finding set can mean the LENSES CRASHED, not that the diff is clean. Check the run's failures + journal.jsonl before treating empty as a pass.
processNotes.userParallelWork: The user commits their own work on main concurrently. ALWAYS git add explicit paths, never -A, and never revert their files.
